title: Resource Planning Analyst Principal | INTEGRATED RESOURCE PLANNING (IRP)
description:
**Job Posting End Date**


10\-09\-2026
Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

**Job Summary**

Are you ready to shape the future of energy? Join American Electric Power’s Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) team and play a pivotal role in transforming how we meet growing electricity demands across our service territories. As a Resource Planning Analyst, you’ll be at the forefront of evaluating and optimizing the mix of power generation resources including renewables, battery energy storage systems (BESS), nuclear resources including small modular nuclear reactors, gas turbines, and emerging technologies that will power millions of homes and businesses.
  

In this role you will be actively engaged in planning for the energy portfolios of tomorrow by managing the preparation of Integrated Resource Plans by obtaining plan content from contributors outside of the Resource Planning organization and developing model input. Evaluating power supply alternatives and presenting findings to higher levels of management. Designing and performing other modeling related studies and analyses. Developing testimony and supporting witnesses in regulatory proceedings.
  

Participate in meetings with outside stakeholders when required by state specific rules in developing operating company resource plans.**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

  

This position is considered an expert in this area within the organization and will initiate, direct and complete power generation resource planning activities including the preparation of inputs to, and the analysis of outputs from, detailed production cost and resource optimization models and the associated analyses for existing and new generation resources, energy efficiency alternatives, fuel and purchased power projections used in Integrated Resource Planning filings, Request for Proposal (RFP) evaluations, corporate strategy discussions, Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) fi

title: Solar Construction Director of EPC
description:
**\-Dallas\-Fort Worth candidates strongly preferred\-**

**The Role**

Lead end\-to\-end EPC delivery for solar PV and battery energy storage (BESS) projects. The work is primarily distributed generation and local solar under 20 MW; utility\-scale experience above 50 MW is a plus. You will own engineering coordination, procurement, field construction, commissioning, and handover so projects meet schedule, budget, quality, safety, and interconnection requirements.

**Strong electrical knowledge is required.** This is an EPC construction leadership role, not an electrician or electrical\-design role. You do not need a journeyman or master electrician license. You do need enough command of PV and BESS electrical systems to review designs, direct electrical subcontractors, and take a site through testing, energization, and utility permission to operate.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the full EPC lifecycle: engineering coordination, vendor and subcontractor procurement, construction execution, commissioning, punchlist, and handover.
* Set and track project milestones, including mechanical completion, electrical completion, testing, site turnover, substantial completion, and commercial operation (COD).
* Run multiple distributed\-generation projects in parallel while protecting cost, schedule, quality, and margin.
* Own budgeting, scheduling, cost\-to\-complete forecasts, change\-order control, and contract administration.
* Direct site work: site preparation, foundations, equipment installation, electrical installation, commissioning, and testing.
* Review electrical design and field work for constructability and readiness — DC and AC collection, inverters or PCS, transformers, switchgear, grounding, single\-line diagrams, and the point of interconnection.
* Oversee electrical subcontractors and the path to energization, including testing, LOTO discipline, utility hold points, and interconnection with Texas utilities / ERCOT as applicable.

description:
TAE Power Solutions (TPS) is the electrification spin\-off from TAE Technologies, a leader in nuclear fusion technology. The company is leveraging unique power management technology originally developed for nuclear fusion and applying it in adjacent industries including Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and DC Fast Charging for electric vehicles.

**About the Role**


The main objective of this role is to identify technical gaps in engineering tasks to ensure scalable and predictable engineering execution. The Senior EDM owns the internal engineering execution architecture. This role turns high\-level engineering objectives into a complete task breakdown with clear owners, dependencies, deliverables, and readiness criteria, ensuring there are no gaps or overlaps across disciplines. The role partners closely with PMO, which owns the integrated master schedule and external communications with customers and vendors, to ensure seamless execution of internal and external milestones.

* Build and maintain the engineering work breakdown structure across systems, electrical, mechanical, controls, software, compliance, test, manufacturing readiness, and field readiness.

* Create phase gate readiness criteria for key milestones such as requirements freeze, design freeze, build readiness FAT readiness, certification readiness, and release readiness.
* Translate engineering changes into task level impacts and provide schedule and resourcing inputs to PMO for baseline updates.

***Operating Cadence and Leadership Partnership***

* Work directly with the Director of Engineering on task planning and scope checks, and highlight critical path risks early.
* Run a recurring engineering execution cadence including weekly progress reviews, dependency reviews, and risk issue decision tracking.
